methods.what: Lagrangian form of the hydrodynamic equations of motion (with respect to the initial coordinate a)
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial x}{\partial a} + \frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial y}{\partial a} + \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial a} + \frac{\partial p}{\partial a} - \frac{\partial U}{\partial a} = 0$

methods.what: Polar coordinates for a rotating motion, with the corresponding velocity components
Radial equation of motion in polar coordinates
Radial equation after eliminating the angular velocity using the angular-momentum constant alpha
Energy (Bernoulli-type) integral of the radial equation
Linear substitution of the coordinates in terms of the initial coordinates
Material derivative of a velocity component, relating Lagrangian and Eulerian forms
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
